_capture.what: the user bubble a birth-details widget answer leaves in a transcript — the ASTRAL-89 echo followed by the typed `input_response` fence, exactly as the server persisted it
_capture.shape_is_the_engines: the envelope, the fence language, the key set (dob/tob/pob) and the echo grammar are VERBATIM from the capture
_capture.values_substituted: YES, deliberately. The captured turn belonged to a THIRD PARTY on a production chat (an adhoc "just this reading"), and checking a real person's birth date, time and place into a git repository is the thing this feature exists to prevent. The date, time and place were replaced with a synthetic set; nothing else was touched. What the tests assert — that the fence identifies the bubble and that no exact value survives the mask — is a property of the SHAPE, not of the values.
